decisions.reason: This express programme builds directly on the firm's existing logistics and fast-response service knowledge, so the firm can interpret its early results and improve it.
As a seventy-two-hour express service, it leverages the firm's established spare-parts logistics and service network, giving high absorptive capacity to learn and refine.
The fire-resistant steel exterior door is close to existing certified door lines and has European approval, so the firm has strong related knowledge to develop it further.

This express delivery programme for doors and gates uses the same logistics and service capabilities as existing offers, though it may overlap with A and B; still, the firm can evaluate and improve it.

The online platform extends the firm's product and service knowledge into digital services, where its absorptive capacity is weaker, so it may be harder to learn and improve; keep for now while evaluating.
The fire and smoke protection door is close to the firm's established safety door expertise, enabling the firm to assimilate market feedback and improve it.
